transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for making time to meet about the middle-school esports team proposal. transcript.text: I need to flag some important issues before we proceed. I checked the league's current registration manual and found that a middle-school team may register exactly eight students — not ten as our draft lists — may field five active players per match, and must use a wired local network rather than ordinary wireless. I have not yet entered those requirements in the activity proposal, so the plan as written would not comply with league rules.

transcript.text: I need to share a logistical concern regarding Jordan. Since the current draft proposes practices running until 5:00 p.m., this creates a conflict for at least one of our ten interested students.

transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Nguyen, for catching those league compliance issues. To add to the picture, we now have several items that need to be resolved before this plan is ready for approval.
